title: Classified Limited Risk under the EU AI Act.
body: LabGenie informs decisions, it doesn't make them, which keeps it in the EU AI Act's lightest tier, with transparency our core obligation.

points.name: Advises, you decide
points.note: LabGenie recommends; people make the call.
